title: Monique F NDE 4694
content: I had to be fighting a cold or whatever it was. I wasn't sure but I knew I was sick. I had a fever, stuffy, runny nose, sneezing, coughing, sore throat, the works. I had been congested, and it was making me have asthma attacks constantly. I even used up all of my inhaler and everything. So about 4:00 am rolls around. I can't breathe, so I try my nebulizer. It made it worse, the worse it has ever been. Nothing was working. So, I stagger to my mom's room and tell her that I need to go to the hospital. She gets up, and I'm sitting on her bed panting like a dog, my body feels like its swelling up with heat and my veins are popping out of my body. I'm sweating like mad and I felt like a hot air balloon. Then my mom helps me with my coat, get to the door, and into the car. I'm falling down while I'm walking for lack of air. She scrapes the windows off. I'm still just barely breathing. She gets in and tries to start the car. Of course, it didn't work. Then all the sudden, I can't see anything, everything just goes black. My eyes are wide open too, so of course, I tell mom and she's telling me to calm down, and not to talk. I start to see something that scares me; I see this skull, it's turning towards me, opening its mouth, its eyes are popping out and bulging like it was almost like a screen saver. There was a checkered psychedelic background behind it, and I thought I was seeing the grim reaper. Truly. Then it disappeared (I heard later from my mom that I had passed out, and was barely breathing) and I saw my whole life flash before my eyes like pictures in a spinning wheel from left to right it was so fast, starting from the present going back to the past. I kept seeing Jason's (my boyfriend) face, and I was saying his name. Later mom told me I was screaming his name at the top of my lungs several times. Then I stopped breathing, my eyes rolled up in my head and she gave me CPR. Then it disappeared, and I saw what I believe was God's outline, with a bright light behind him. I truly believe I saw him, I asked him not to take me repeatedly, and that I was going to do better with my life if he would give me another chance. After I said that, I could see again. I was so disoriented. I saw a man standing in front of me. I was apparently muttering things, and mom was trying to get me to focus. I don't know when this part happened, but I saw this star in the sky, and it got closer and closer and brighter and brighter. Finally, I sat up. The ambulance arrived and I went to the hospital. I hardly remember any of it, but I remember trying to grab the emergency medical technician's jacket, and telling them thank you, and then they whisked me to the emergency room. They took my blood a bunch of times; they did many tests to figure out what was wrong, so eventually they told me I had to stay until the next day. They transported me to my room and all that, gave me a bunch of medications throughout the day.

arrival.other_being_detail: Experiencer reports seeing what she believed was "God's outline, with a bright light behind him."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe asthma attack / inability to breathe while sick with fever and congestion; mother later reported she passed out, was barely breathing, and required CPR.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also reported frightening imagery: darkness/blackout and a skull with a psychedelic checkered background; later a star in the sky getting closer and brighter.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout and frightening skull imagery, then a rapid life-flash, then seeing what she believed was God's outline with bright light; vision returned and she later sat up as ambulance arrived.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Vision of a skull (grim reaper-like) turning toward her with bulging eyes and open mouth against a checkered psychedelic background; later a star in the sky moving closer and brighter.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I saw my whole life flash before my eyes like pictures in a spinning wheel from left to right it was so fast"; "I saw what I believe was God's outline, with a bright light behind him."; "I asked him not to take me repeatedly"
